verdict.rationale: The README documents the ability to 'Query and edit large codebases'. One hands-on user reports throwing very large codebases at it and having it navigate and learn them effortlessly, which supports exploration without manual file selection. Another user reports it is slow and weak at codebase navigation, a mixed signal that lowers confidence but does not contradict the capability itself. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of automatic repo-wide context discovery or mapping, any documented codebase-explanation or architecture-overview workflow, and consistent independent corroboration of navigation quality.

support.subject: As a developer, I can have the agent map and explain an entire unfamiliar codebase without manually selecting context files

citations.quote: I have thrown very large codebases at this and it has been able to navigate and learn them effortlessly.
